book.name: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan
book.title: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan Mulai neme Manetualain Ana tao lalai no daebafok

content: Dae mulai mada
Tehuu Manetualain taa nafalende heni Noh asa, no basa banda la malai ofak ndia. Boe ma, Ana fee ani nafumbu, fo tao naleꞌe faa ndia.
Boe ma, Ana tatana basa oe mata kala, malai daebafok, ma Ana fee uda hahae, neme lalai mai.
De oe leꞌe nakandoo. Basa faik natun esa lima hulu, boe ma oe taa demak nalan seli so.
Nandaa no bulak kahitun seli faik sanahulu hitu, boe ma ofak ndia hala neu lete madema esa lain, naden Ararat.
Oe leꞌe nakandoo losa bulak kasanahulun fain esa, boe ma lete kala mboi nala sadu.
Seli faik haa hulu, boe ma Noh soi ofak jendelan esa.
De ana mboꞌi mbui kaa esa. Mbuik ndia, laa nakandoo neu-mai, losa oe ana leꞌe tetebes. Ana taa fali neni ofak neu so.
Boe ma, Noh mboꞌi seluk lunda esa bali, fo sangga ana bubuluk oe ndia, leꞌe tetebes so, do beik.
Tehuu, huu oe bei mboti nala basan, de mbuik ndia taa hambu mamana sasaꞌek. De ana fali neni ofak neu. Noh look liman, de ana simbo falik mbuik ndia, neni ofak dale neu.
Noh nahani faik hitu bali, de ana mboꞌi seluk mbuik ndia.
Ledo bobon ndia, mbuik ndia fali neni Noh neu, ma neni ai setun dok esa, fo bei fo ana tutu nalan. Basa boe ma, Noh bubuluk, oe leꞌe tetebes so.
Ana nahani faik hitu bali, boe ma ana mboꞌi seluk mbui lunda ndia. Tehuu oek ia, mbuik ndia taa fali so.
Faik fo Noh teun natun nee ma esa, fo laꞌeneu bula kaesan fain esa, k oe leꞌe tetebes so. Boe ma Noh soi ofak jendelan, de ana suli nafeok, tehuu dae mada so.
Losa bulak kaduan fain kadua hulu hitun, bali, boe ma dae mada ndoos so.
Basa boe ma, Manetualain kokolak no Noh nae,
“Noh! Hatematak ia, ei basa nggei konda leo mima ofak ia mai.
Kalua heni basa banda la sila! Fo ndia: banda nakaboik, banda fui, banda mana lae-lodok, ma mbui kala. Ela basa sala boe lamanoꞌu, fo tao lahenu daebafok ia.”
Basa boe ma, Noh no saon, ana nala, ma fetofeu nala, basa sala kalua leme ofak ndia mai. Basa banda la sila, kalua, esa-esak no ndia numban.
Noh tao tunu-hotuk makasi soaneu Manetualain

Boe ma, Noh nakatotodok batu, fo tao mei tunu-hotuk fee LAMATUAK. Noh haꞌi nala esa-esak neme banda la, fo bole paken neu tunu-hotuk, de ana hala sala, ma ana tunu sala neu mei tunu-hotuk ndia lain, fo dadik tanda makasi neu LAMATUAK.

Faik fo LAMATUAK hae laꞌe tunu-hotuk ndia naboo meni, boe ma dalen namahoko. De Ana duduꞌa nae, “Mulai neme hatematak ia mai, Au taa sumba-soo daebafok ia bali, huu hataholi manggalaun. Mae kada ala duduꞌa manggalauk neme kadiꞌi anan mai, tehuu Au taa tao akalulutu basa masoda kala so, sama leo Au taok ndia so.

Mete ma daebafok ia bei nai ia, na, basa fai-fai la laꞌok lakandoo, tungga ndia heti-heun. Fo ndia: fai sele-nggalin ma fai ketu-kolun, fai makasufun ma fai hanan, fai hanan ma fai oefaan, leledok ma leꞌodaek.”
